sources.topic: Local numeric/string reads, position/joint functions and explicit TP caller scope; joint return-type heading is inconsistent with its JOINTPOS purpose
Local INTEGER/REAL, string and grouped Cartesian/extended/joint writes
Local frame/tool and representation/axis queries, default groups and uninitialized-position sentinel

implementation.selection: Explicit KAREL root name to existing TP record bindings; linked routines retain calling root, scheduler rename retains program identity; no selected-program/global-bank fallback
implementation.storage: Per-record numeric and bounded ASCII string banks and independent grouped position registers; existing program positions/comments remain separate
implementation.access: No open handle required; foreign handle rejection masks apply to read or read/write access, own root handles do not block
implementation.persistence: Detached typed JSON with bindings/limits/values; copy detaches all local banks without rebinding callers; terminal execution retains values, omits handles
implementation.outputs: GET_TPE_REG changes flag and selected numeric output only; complete string destination required; position functions return detached extended or padded nine-axis values

portable_choices.limits: Each register limit 1..32767, default 32767; ASCII string capacity 1..254, default 254; store groups remain explicit
portable_choices.groups: Optional final group for position functions/setters and optional middle group for frame/type procedures; calling root default or group 1; host defaults to group 1
portable_choices.positions: Cartesian normalization to requested representation, exact joint widths, no implicit kinematics, retained external axes and frame/tool IDs; new IDs 0/0
portable_choices.strings: Source writes truncate to bank capacity; constructor strings must fit; undersized read destination preserves output and returns 8
portable_choices.status: 0 success; 1 numeric/string missing; 2 address/representation; 4 sharing; 8 small string destination; 9 no caller; 17038 position absent
portable_choices.failed_getters: Publish status then raise without replacing assignment target
